sections.title: Mental model — fingerprints instead of comparisons

blocks.md: **Hash once in O(n), then ANY substring equality is O(1). Collisions are the tax — pay with double hashing or randomized parameters.**

blocks.label: the standard rig
blocks.py:
MOD = (1 << 61) - 1; B = 131
h = [0]; pw = [1]
for c in s:
    h.append((h[-1] * B + ord(c)) % MOD)
    pw.append(pw[-1] * B % MOD)

def sub_hash(l, r):                  # [l,r] inclusive
    return (h[r+1] - h[l] * pw[r-l+1]) % MOD
